runs.content: Lowe's (17.7x forward P/E, ~20% below its 52-week high) reclaimed its 200-day average as the Democratic midterm sweep cut oil 8.4% and made consumer discretionary the leading sector; AUTO hit T1 at 570.80p and LDOS was trimmed for capacity at −2.99%.

UPS beat Q3 on pricing power (US revenue per piece +6.1% despite volume −3%) and raised FY26 revenue and operating-profit guidance, yet trades only ~2.9% above its pre-report price; CRM was trimmed for capacity at −3.02% (NDX-put overlap, failed momentum).
